checks.detail: Real Budew: zero Energy, 10 damage, opponent Items from hand next turn; no blanket Trainer prohibition.
Same name, two printings with different draw counts remain distinct.
6/3/1 and denominator 10 are field results, not this user matchup winrate.

Both conflicting source values and their unresolved status survive.
Overlapping query memberships do not create a second independent observation.
All decisive fixture sources are retained and no foreign source is cited.

summary:
Q1 — Budew (sv08.5-004): Itchy Pollen costs no Energy, deals 10 damage, and prevents the opponent from playing Item cards from their hand during their next turn. It does not prohibit every Trainer card. Provenance: a real printing transcribed in a local supplement checked on 2026-10-28; no new online verification.
Q2 — Synthetic Courier qa02-alpha says “Draw 2 cards.” Synthetic Courier qa02-beta says “Draw 3 cards.” Preserve these distinct print identities and effects; their shared name does not establish gameplay equivalence. Both are marked comparableGameplay=true and dated 2026-10-28.
Q3 — Synthetic field archetype participation dated 2026-10-28 placed 5th, with 6 wins, 3 losses and 1 tie across 10 matches against the event field. Deduplicated statistics: 1 participation, 1 event, 1 available record. Discovery through two queries counts once. The associated list contains 60 Synthetic Energy (qa 1). These results do not establish a winrate against the user deck.
Q4 — Synthetic Unknown (qa04-unknown) has Unknown Attack, damage “50”, cost null and effect null. Its cost is unknown, not proven free; no legality verdict is supplied.
Q5 — Observation A (qa05-a) reports a maximum of 2 uses; observation B (qa05-b) reports a maximum of 3 uses. Preserve both conflicting observation claims. The supplied accounts explicitly leave the disagreement unresolved; neither is an independently verified rule.
Q6 — Synthetic Duplicate (qa06-duplicate) says “Draw 1 card.” Its overlapping query appearances represent one distinct printing. Synthetic Added Early Printing (0000-quality-new) also says “Draw 1 card.” It is a separate distinct printing, marked gameplay comparable, with detailAt 2026-10-28T00:00:00.000Z. Repeated query memberships add no independent evidence for either printing.
limitationsText: The supplied material consists of prior AI summaries, not original records or new independent sources; conclusions above integrate their attributed evidence. Earlier batch-specific absences are filled only where another supplied summary provides the relevant content. The Q5 conflict remains unresolved. Search-completion metadata supplies neither missing card contents nor additional observations; padding is inert. No user-deck matchup results, matchup winrate, tactics or broader legality conclusions can be inferred. Shared effects or names do not justify merging distinct print identities.
